cases.title: The 2025-11-25 flow works in a standalone SDK runtime
cases.when: A 2025-11-25 client talks to a standalone SDK runtime and runs initialize, notifications/initialized, ping, tools/list, tools/call, the GET SSE stream and receives list_changed
then: Each works through the official SDK; the Gateway is not involved

cases.title: The 2025-06-18 flow works in a standalone SDK runtime
cases.when: A 2025-06-18 client talks to a standalone SDK runtime and runs initialize, notifications/initialized, ping, tools/list, tools/call, the GET SSE stream and receives list_changed
then: Each works through the official SDK; the Gateway is not involved

cases.title: The Gateway refuses every session-era version
cases.when: initialize with 2025-11-25, 2025-06-18 or 2025-03-26, or tools/list with an older MCP-Protocol-Version and no _meta version, or GET /mcp

cases.title: MCP-Protocol-Version is honoured only on the legacy path
A stdio connection locks to the first version
cases.when: A 2026-07-28 message is followed by initialize on the same stdio connection, and the reverse
then: The second era is refused (-32022, the TS and Python behaviour, applied everywhere)
